content.text: Register doesn't pass a provider, so the default in `UsersService.create` is used.

candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is missing. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then sees provider !== 'email' and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'. The default should be AuthProvidersEnum.email.
register does not set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly when creating the user, so it relies on the wrong default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Change the default provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
